IMP CAESAR [VESPASIANVS] AVG ; COS [ITER T]R POT (RIC II (2nd ed), p

Silver denarius of Vespasian (AD 66-79). Mint of Rome , AD 70. Obverse has a laureate head facing right with the legend IMP CAESAR [VESPASIANVS] AVG. The reverse has Pax seated facing left, holding branch and caduceus and the legend COS [ITER T]R POT (RIC II (2nd ed), p. 16, no. 10; Reece Period 4). Diameter: 17.56mm; weight: 2.4g.
